title: Faceoff/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Aoi: "Listen up, squad. You do what I say and you'll come out of this alive. You do what I say fast and you'll get to eat the most delicious pizza of your life. Any questions? No? Good."
- Aoi: "Arthur's outlined three crucial objectives for us to clear. Stakes could not be higher: my dignity is on the line. I do not want to go behind the Big Bytes counter tonight. Understood?"
- Aoi: "Okay squad, you are the biggest, baddest warriors under Sol. You're gonna go out there and you're gonna be faster than lightning. And then the lightning will make us a pizza."
- Aoi: "Ick. Nasty Techrot baddies up ahead. Do me a favor, and take out the trash."
- Aoi: "Time to get rid of the overgrown Techrot stomping around like they own this city. Pfft. Like they even paid taxes?! "
- Aoi: "We must be on their radar, 'cause Scaldra's deployed their muscle. Marking hardened units for elimination."
- Aoi: "Time to sow a little confusion in the ranks. Marking targets: Scaldra commanders."
- Aoi: "Ouch. That one hurt to watch."
- Aoi: "Line em up, knock em down."
- Aoi: "A Mobile Voice broadcast balloon has been discovered and is taking damage. Get there and provide support. This city deserves better than unrelenting Scaldra propaganda."
- Aoi: "A Mobile Voice broadcast broadcast balloon is under attack. Help them. This one's personal. Music is everything."
- Aoi: "That's the Mobile Voice balloon. Keep it clear of all attackers and bust up any signal jammers you find to keep it moving."
- Aoi: "Hey, you found the balloon. Keep it safe, and smash any signal jammers. I do not want to go back to listening to Viktor droning on all day."
- Aoi: "Jammers nearby! The sooner you take them out, the sooner Mobile Voice will be safe. "
- Aoi: "Stay on top of those jammers, squad."
- Aoi: "Balloon's taken too much damage. It's doing its recovery mode thing. Smashing jammers will hurry it up."
- Aoi: "Ack. Recovery mode. Quick, kill any jammers, that'll get it moving faster."
- Aoi: "Pump up the volume. We are coming in crystal clear all across Höllvania. Well done."
- Aoi: "Looks like the broadcast is safe for now. Let's keep moving."
- Aoi: "It's time to burn… a compact disk! A nearby data server contains megabytes of Scaldra comms logs. Get to the server I'll trigger the write."

- Aoi: "Need you to burn a CD for me at that data server by keeping it powered. NO- it's not the unreleased On-lyne demo songs. This is tactical information critical to our mission! I got the demo days ago."
- Aoi: "Ready? One compact disk coming up. Find fuel for the generators."
- Aoi: "CD is writing. Server power dropping. Need to fuel that generator. Find gas."
- Aoi: "Scaldra units have our gas cans. They just don't know it yet."
- Aoi: "Scaldra often carry emergency gas cans. You could ask them nicely to borrow? Or not nicely."
- Aoi: "We're at full power! Any excess fuel will boost the burn speed."
- Aoi: "Look at you squad, you maxed out the gennie. Routing excess power to burn speed."
- Aoi: "You think that server is going to power itself? Come on squad, find some jerry cans."
- Aoi: "No time for marker art. Pocket that CD and run."
- Aoi: "Aannnnd… DONE. Pick that CD up and go."
- Aoi: "Civvies are pinned down in this sector. Scaldra on the surface and Techrot down below. Clear the area. Give them some breathing room."
- Aoi: "This area is crawling with hostile forces. Scaldra, Techrot, doesn't matter we need to take them out."
- Aoi: "Whoa. Did you even leave anything for Amir's squad?"
- Aoi: "Enemy resistance has been severely weakened, hopefully that gives the local civies some breathing room."
- Aoi: "Seeing a lockbox. You know the drill. I've marked approximate key locations on your map."
- Aoi: "Ooh. Scaldra lockbox on radar. That means goodies! Keys can be found in the marked vicinity. Taking out enemies will help me narrow down their location."
- Aoi: "High ranking units may have their own keys."
- Aoi: "Take out heavy units, they're often issued passkeys."
- Aoi: "That's the first passkey. Timer's ticking, use it or lose it."
- Aoi: "Passkey! Hurry or you'll end up like my second-cousin who liked to play pranks with fireworks."
- Aoi: "This belongs to the people anyway."
- Aoi: "Okay. So one of our "Sensor Clusters" is getting beat up. You know how long it took me to source all those parts. Make sure they stay safe."
- Aoi: "A Sensor Cluster is under attack?! Must have picked up something important. Get down there and protect it. Now."
- Aoi: "Protect sensor cluster so it can finish its scan of the Techrot."
- Aoi: "That cluster is gathering crucial data on the Techrot. It must be allowed to finish its scan."
- Aoi: "Jammers in the area. Seek and destroy."
- Aoi: "Sensor Jammers. Slowing us down. Smash those things."
- Aoi: "Sensor Cluster just crapped out on us. It'll reboot faster if you take out Jammers."
- Aoi: "Sensors down. Maybe while it reboots you all can brainstorm ways to keep it from taking so much damage?!"
- Aoi: "Finished. What a relief. You know how long it took me to find all those parts for Amir?"
- Aoi: "Let's go! Sensor cluster intact. Scan complete."
- Aoi: "Uh oh. Did we do that?"
- Aoi: "What's the matter, Amir? Squad having trouble all of a sudden?"
- Aoi: "There should be a rule against this… but there isn't."

path: First To Be In The Lead
lines: - Aoi: "Don't look now, Amir. We just took the lead."
- Aoi: "Try not to choke on all our dust, little buddy."
- Aoi: "Don't let this get you down, Amir. My squad is just really, really good."

path: In The Lead After Second Objective
lines: - Aoi: "Would you look at that, Amir, we're still in the lead."
- Aoi: "Hate to break it to you, Amir, you guys are in second place. Also known as last place."
- Aoi: "Catch up, Amir. I want this to be fair."
- Aoi: "I need to see some hustle."
- Aoi: "It's too close to call, let's put some distance between us and them."
- Aoi: "I'm sorry. I thought you were HUNGRY! My mistake."

path: First To Reach The Last Objective
lines: - Aoi: "Who's hungry? I know I am."
- Aoi: "It's okay, Amir. There's no shame in being second best."

path: Taking The Lead During The Last Objective
If Winning Before Last Objective Is Finished
If Losing Before Last Objective Is Finished
lines: - Aoi: "Guys! We got to pick it up. I hate pineapple on my pizza."
- Aoi: "Squad. We cannot lose to Amir. The gloating will never stop."
- Aoi: "Extract yourselves, you beautiful and capable squad, you."
- Amir: "Hope you've been practicing your dough spinning, Aoi, cause you're going to be slinging some 'zas tonight."
- Amir: "For this squad, victory was never in question."
- Amir: "The real treasure is the friends we made along- Nah… it's the pizza."
- Aoi: "Hey, we helped the people of Höllvania and that's what counts. Get to the extraction point."
- Aoi: "Amir is NEVER gonna let me live this down. Time to come home."
- Amir: "Okay, squad. Saddle up and bring your appetites, Aoi's making pizza tonight."
- Amir: "Squad Amir! That's you. Listen up. We do our objectives fast, and we do them right, and then Aoi puts on an apron and a tiny little hat and makes us pizza."
- Amir: "We're going to fight them in the streets! We're going to fight them in the sewers! We're going to fight until Aoi makes us a deep dish with triple cheese."
- Amir: "Trio of double-XL Techrot up ahead. Cut 'em down to size."
- Amir: "Detecting big-boy Techrot in the vicinity. Too dangerous to leave roaming. Take 'em out."
- Amir: "High-ranking Scaldra have made the mistake of leading from the front. Put them in the ground."
- Amir: "Detecting targets of opportunity: Scaldra middle-management. Cull 'em."
- Amir: "Quick and efficient. A squad after my own heart."
- Amir: "Intercept and protect the Mobile Voice broadcast balloon. I want to be able to turn on my radio without hearing Scaldra, Scaldra, Scaldra."
- Amir: "Mobile Voice, you know, resistance radio, their broadcast balloon is under attack. They need our help. Fast."
- Amir: "Don't let anything happen to the balloon. Smash jammers to widen the signal window so the balloon can move faster."
- Amir: "Here we go. Take down anything trying to hurt the balloon. And take out any jammers in the area, that'll let the balloon speed up a bit."
- Amir: "Transmission strength is waning. If you take out the jammers that balloon can move a little faster."
- Amir: "They're jamming our signal and it doesn't even taste like strawberries."
- Amir: "Signal jammer is causing the balloon to reduce velocity to manage the signal vector- eh… just smash the jammer."
- Amir: "That little guy is struggling to recover. Try taking out some jammers so it can route more power to its prop."
- Amir: "Balloon's in recovery mode. Take out the jammers to speed it up."
- Amir: "Static easing. Signal returning. You did it. Mobile Voice radio is back on the dial."
- Amir: "Number one with a bullet. Many bullets actually. Höllvanian resistance lives to broadcast another day!"
- Amir: "There's a Scaldra server up ahead, need its manifest file, we're talking hundreds of megabytes. That's right. We need to burn a CD."
- Amir: "Next stop: data server. It's full of juicy, juicy data, but it's not like we can just copy it onto a floppy; too big. Nope you need to help me burn a CD."
- Amir: "Checking parameters… CD Burn is a go. Look for gas cans."
- Amir: "2x burn speed??? Pfff. Start grabbing gas cans."
- Amir: "Need gas? Some troops carry gas cans if you catch my drift...murder them."
- Amir: "These gas cans are nearly empty. Scaldra must be running low on fuel too."
- Amir: "Battery maxed. Routing excess power to the burn. We're talking 4, 8, maybe even 16x speed, baby."
- Amir: "100% power. We're overclocking the burn now, keep those gas cans coming."
- Amir: "Ah, server's gone dark, there's still time to salvage the burn. Look for a gas can."
- Amir: "Server says: Power failure. Systems down. Bring me petroleum gasoline."
- Amir: "Ding! CD ready. Grab and go."
- Amir: "It's done! Take the CD, we do not have time for a sleeve."
- Amir: "That's it. Make sure you don't scratch it."
- Amir: "The city was a dangerous cesspool, until one squad took matters into their own hands and swept away the filth. That squad's you guys, now make with the bang, bang."
- Amir: "Clowns to the left of me, mutated consumer electronic monstrosities to the right. Uh… you get the picture, eliminate nearby resistance."
- Amir: "Wow. Remind me to never get on this squad's bad side."
- Amir: "Whoa. Slow down. They've had enough. For now."
- Amir: "Lockbox up ahead. Scaldra doesn't trust its people, so the box needs multiple keys to unlock. Find the keys and get that box open."
- Amir: "A mysterious box. Multiple keys and a self-destruct sequence. Will one squad walk away with the treasure, or will it all go up in smoke?"
- Amir: "Take note: the biggest baddies are known to carry passkeys."
- Amir: "Look for heavy units, they may carry keys."
- Amir: "You got a passkey. Take it to the lockbox before it goes poof."
- Amir: "These passkeys have a self-annihilation protocol when held by unauthorized personnel. Spoiler alert, that's you."
- Amir: "Well what do we have here?"
- Amir: "Phew. Can you imagine if it was empty? That would be a bummer."
- Amir: "Get to the marked Sensor Cluster. I'm running a script to harvest Techrot chatter. Trying to figure out how rot communicates. Go there now. Hurry."
- Amir: "Ugh… One of my Sensor Clusters is under attack. Guess the Techrot don't like me harvesting their packets. Destination marked."
- Amir: "Protect the unit until it finishes its scan."
- Amir: "That's my cluster. Thing of beauty! It is imperative that it can finish its scan."
- Amir: "Jammers are interfering with the sensor sweep. You know what to do."
- Amir: "Signal… losing… strength… must smash… jammer."
- Amir: "Sensor rebooting! Take out Jammers and it will reboot faster."
- Amir: "Too much damage. Scanning halted. Standby."
- Amir: "They didn't even see it coming."
- Amir: "Scan complete. And ohh… That information is… concerning. Ah we'll deal with that later. For hoo-ray, you did it."
- Amir: "Scan is… done. Woah. The Techrot did not appreciate that. Reminds me of the last time I went to the doctor."
- Amir: "That should grease the wheels a bit."
- Amir: "I was just going to suggest you do that. I was. Really."

path: First to be in the lead
lines: - Amir: "Uh oh, Aoi, looks like my squad's winning this thing. Whatcha gonna do."
- Amir: "Hey Aoi, hope you like pineapple on your pizza, cause my squad just took the lead."
- Amir: "All the girls I've dated, they both said I'm the fastest. So it should come as no surprise that my squad is winning."

path: In the lead after second Objective
lines: - Amir: "Looks like we continue to be on a one way trip to Winsville."
- Amir: "Oh, I'm sorry, Aoi, did you need my squad to slow down so your guys could catch up?"
- Amir: "Just so you know, Aoi, I like two cans of pineapple on my pizza."
- Amir: "It's a virtual tie! Go. GO. GO!"
- Amir: "It's anyone's match at this point."

path: Reaching the Last Objective before Aoi
lines: - Amir: "Aoi, how could you think you'd be faster than me?"

path: Taking the lead during the last Objective
lines: - Amir: "Oh, hey Aoi, almost didn't see you in our rear view mirror."
- Amir: "Aoooiiiiee. Don't know if you noticed this yet. But we just took the lead."
- Amir: "Squad Amir rounds the corner, they're taking the inside track. Can they do it? Yes they can. Squad Amir takes the lead."

path: If winning before last Objective is finished
lines: - Amir: "We have got this thing in the bag."
- Amir: "Visualize the pizza. You want the pizza. Pizza is for winners."

path: If losing before last Objective is finished
lines: - Amir: "Hey Squad, we need to pick up the pace. Chop chop. Come on."
- Amir: "If Aoi wins this thing, she'll never let me forget it."
- Amir: "Can't you go faster. I could go faster."
- Amir: "We did it. Head back to Central."
- Amir: "Time to blow this pop stand."
- Aoi: "Second place, first loser. Don't worry Amir, you're the number one pizza chef in my books."
- Aoi: "Wooo-hooo, squad, you did it. Hope, you're hungry because Amir's slinging pies tonight."
- Amir: "Come on home. I'll start prepping the dough."
- Amir: "It's all over, squad. I know you tried. Get to extraction."
